sources.classification: labelled from the task code, 2026-10-10: a recommender (embeddings + MLP) fits no leaf workload, so `training`; precision fp32 (the benchmark's FP16 set passes no --amp); params = (138 493 users + 26 744 items) x (64 + 128) embedding weights + MLP and final layers = 31.83 M; dataset_samples = MovieLens-20M ratings minus one test rating per user (20 000 263 - 138 493), each epoch adds 4 negatives per positive
